submission.reasoning: The evidence supports a brief, reverted firewall configuration test rather than persistent attacker access. At 04:19:04, WORKSTATION5\wardog used the Windows netsh executable to allow inbound TCP port 450 under the name "remote support". The same cmd.exe parent launched the matching delete command approximately 4.6 seconds later. Registry telemetry confirms deletion of the exact firewall-rule key at 04:19:09.135Z, demonstrating actual rollback rather than merely an attempted cleanup. The examined activity does not establish malicious payload execution or persistence.
